notes.title: How the English Edition Relates to the Chinese Edition
notes.text: This English edition is authored as a meaning-equivalent monograph rather than a literal sentence-by-sentence translation. Both editions share the same canonical claim identifiers, primary-source evidence records, and exact-arithmetic teaching cases, while allowing clearly labeled edition-specific reader notes where terminology or institutional context differs. Chapters are published progressively by part; unpublished chapters remain listed on the English Book Guide with direct links to their complete Chinese counterparts.
